svg.text: Proposal–Permission Privilege Split on Heterogeneous Silicon
UNTRUSTED PROPOSAL ENGINE (Linux MPU / Edge NPU)
• Multi-Modal Foundation Models (VLMs), Vision Encoders (ViTs / DINOv2), Action Chunk Decoders (Diffusion / ACT)
• Asynchronous Deliberation: 1 Hz Semantic Intent → 20–50 Hz Action Chunking (Amortizes Inference Delay)
• Emits: Expiring Intent Leases pt = ⟨SE(3) Target, Workspace Bounding Volume, t_expire, Monotonic Counter⟩
Shared SRAM Mailbox · Expiring Proposal pt (TTL ≤ 100 ms)
• Dedicated 1000 Hz Timing Loop: Zero Dynamic Memory Heap (Static SRAM buffers only)
• Minimal-Intervention Control Barrier Functions (CBF: h(x) ≥ 0) + Dynamic Stopping Clearance (d_stop ≤ d_clear)
• Two-Stage Emergency Interlock (IEC 60204-1): Heartbeat Watchdog Timeout (> 20 ms) → SS1 Dynamic Halt → Safe Torque Off
Permitted Phase Currents ut = permit(pt) (Space Vector PWM @ 20 kHz)
THE PHYSICAL WORLD (Irreversible State Mutation: Wt ──► Wt+1)
• 3-Phase MOSFET Inverters · Stator Magnetic Flux · Kinetic Momentum (p = mv) · Joule Heating (I²R)
• Endogenous Feedback: Physical Mutation Wt+1 Instantly Shapes Next Sensory Observation Ot+1
